description_en: Describes the syntax and provides examples of the video OCR operation RecognizeVideoCastCrewList
description_zh: 本文介绍视频OCR RecognizeVideoCastCrewList的语法及示例

parameters.help_en: The URL of the video. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) URL in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored locally or the OSS URL is in a region other than China (Shanghai), see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 视频URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: video_url

element_fields.help_en:

subtitles: subtitle extraction.
cast: cast and crew list extraction
element_fields.help_zh:
视频信息提取类型：
subtitles：字幕提取。

parameters.help_en: The parameters that control the output of scenario results
